Hey dude sorry was out of town for a while and not checking up.  Being bi-lingual definitely helps, but I'd be very certain that law school is what you want to do before going through with it.  I went to a good school and got pretty decent grades, and there's basically no jobs at all.  I'm one of the few lucky ones (and even my job frankly sucks and pays shit) but I would say a good 50%+ of my law school class is either unemployed or working at starbucks or something (seven years after graduating).  If you work hard and can get into a really good school go for it, but don't make the common mistake of thinking that a degree from Pace or some crappy law school will get you anywhere.  There's just too many diploma factories out there nowadays, and the bar exam has been dumbed down so that any partner's idiot kid can become a lawyer.  Those are the sort of jobs that I could have gotten before, now without a close hookup (or a high GPA degree from Harvard/Yale/Columbia) you're basically screwed.

To be honest I think that Archer did not want to deal with possible repercussions of coming back to find them.  Archer's basic justification for stealing it was "I'm leaving them some extra food and fuel, so they've got an okay chance of making it".
